talleres.intro:
Where hands tell stories

Every Fely Campo piece is born close by. In our atelier and two small workshops in the sierra, skilled hands transform each fabric with time, precision and sensitivity. Behind those hands are women, craft and territory.

visitaAtelier.titulo: Of women, For women, by women
visitaAtelier.texto: Fely Campo was born in Salamanca as a women's fashion house in 1997. Specialised in party and bridal collections, the house has become a benchmark in the industry, both at home and abroad, thanks to its commitment to quality and timeless design.
